347:t_2:68.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$ saved us from that crisis.」

347:t_2:69.en:
$$桂$$
「Is that god with you guys too, $$甲児$$?」

347:t_2:70.en:
$$甲児$$
「No... $$ゼウス$$ is fighting $$バアル$$ on his own, so he's operating separately from us.」

347:t_2:71.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「After that, the two forces were each thrown into some parallel world... Positionally, a beautiful universe at the center of the galaxy.」

347:t_2:72.en:
$$宗介$$
「So you went through the same process as we did...」

347:t_2:73.en:
$$甲児$$
「In our case, we were each sent to Jupiter after that, and regrouped there, though.」

347:t_2:74.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「At Jupiter, we were taken in by a $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ base, and received $$刹那$$'s $$ダブルオークアンタ$$ there, but...」

347:t_2:75.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We ran into a new enemy, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

347:t_2:77.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's short for Extraterrestrial Living Metal Shapeshifter.」

347:t_2:78.en:
$$マオ$$
「So basically, they're weird metal living things from space, right?」

347:t_2:79.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Creatures from space that are hostile to humanity...」

347:t_2:81.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...I can't say for certain yet, but what makes the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ terrifying is the fusion caused by their erosion ability.」

347:t_2:82.en:
$$桂$$
「Fusion...? You mean they swallow up a machine and become one with their own body?」

347:t_2:83.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Exactly. On top of that, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$'s attacks also damage the mind and brain of the pilot aboard.」

347:t_2:84.en:
$$甲児$$
「Once that damage piles up and you can't fight anymore, there's no escaping the erosion.」

347:t_2:85.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why a pilot who's taken a lot of damage has no choice but to withdraw.」

347:t_2:86.en:
$$マオ$$
「Another real pain has shown up, huh...」

347:t_2:87.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「We don't know whether the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ that appeared near Jupiter were transferred by accident, or if they're an advance party...」

347:t_2:88.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But we can't communicate with them, and we know neither their identity nor their purpose, so as things stand, staying on guard is the only way we can deal with them.」

347:t_2:89.en:
$$マオ$$
「...Anyway, I get it. That we and Earth are in huge trouble.」

347:t_2:90.en:
$$桂$$
「From outer space, all kinds of $$バアル$$ are attacking, and on Earth, the $$サイデリアル$$ and their collaborators are acting like they own the place.」

347:t_2:91.en:
$$宗介$$
「The answer is simple. We crush all of it.」

347:t_2:92.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's why we're heading to Earth.」

347:t_2:93.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... If everything is an enemy, we'll just fight everything.」

347:t_2:94.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me, $$千鳥$$... We... I will definitely rescue you.)

347:t_2:103.en:
$n
「...Sorry! Is it time for the briefing?」

347:t_2:104.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No, it's not that. I just came to see how you're doing.」

347:t_2:105.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It looks like you still need time to sort out your thoughts...」

347:t_2:107.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't push yourself. I'll come get you again when it's time to eat.」

347:t_2:108.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Torn between hope and despair... Learning that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is alive makes his hope swell, and his despair grow along with it...)

347:t_10:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Looks like $n still needs more time.」

347:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... There seem to be some rather complicated circumstances.」

347:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You mean $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$?」

347:t_10:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Ever since he infiltrated our ranks on $$翠の地球$$, he's shown a strong fixation on $$セツコ$$.」

347:t_10:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「At first I thought it was some romance thing or the like, but it seems to be something else...」

347:t_10:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I don't know. But we'll need to stay careful from here on.」

347:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「True, when $$バルビエル$$ fought you, $$クロウ$$, his tension rose higher than usual.」

347:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I added the $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z produced at that time to the unit's stock.」

347:t_10:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Nah... I was just thinking, I wish money would pop up that easily too, not just $$Ｚチップ$$...」

347:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sigh... Talking with a miser like you, $$クロウ$$, gets me down.」

347:t_10:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Coming from a Chip-miser like you?!」

347:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Pleased to meet you, $$万丈$$. I am $$ＡＧ$$, agent robot of $$ＤＥＭ$$.」

347:t_10:23.en:
$$万丈$$
「Thank you for the courteous greeting. I look forward to working with you from now on, $$ＡＧ$$.」

347:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all. From now on, I'd like to build a good relationship with the $$破嵐$$ Conglomerate as well...」

347:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies...! It seems my focus was a little off.」

347:t_10:27.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Hey, hey, you're a dimensional merchant who travels across parallel worlds, right?」

347:t_10:28.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Could that $$破嵐$$ Conglomerate from before be the $$万丈$$ of a parallel world?」

347:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh! The two beautiful assistants are here as well!」

347:t_10:30.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Of course. Where $$万丈$$ goes, I go.」

347:t_10:31.en:
$$レイカ$$
「We look forward to working with you, $$ＡＧ$$.」

347:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well... By all means, I shall be looked after.」

347:t_10:33.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Then, back to what we were talking about earlier...」

347:t_10:34.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Hey, what's the parallel world's $$万丈$$ like? Of course, the one next to him was me, right?」

347:t_10:35.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「What are you saying, $$レイカ$$! It's obviously me!」

347:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Understood. If you two are going to squabble that much, I'll tell you just a little of an episode I know.」

347:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that world, $$万丈$$ runs a private detective agency in a sea city floating in Tokyo Bay.」

347:t_10:41.en:
$$レイカ$$
「A private detective... In that case, his partner would be me, the $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ prep school student, right?」

347:t_10:43.en:
$$トッポ$$
「...Looks like this is going to be a long one, Big Bro $$万丈$$.」
